verdict.rationale: Check is a payroll API platform, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis to ask about. The pack documents no retention settings, retention periods, or privacy-driven deletion of employee or company data. The only deletion mention (check-docs-3) is deleting a payroll object as part of the payroll workflow, which is an adjacent operation rather than a retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
